title: Yellow Gooey Dutch Uni Bake
description: A briny and gooey Dutch dish featuring uni, perfect for a hangover cure, made with low sodium ingredients and wood-fired baking
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shredded Gouda cheese to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Add the uni to the bowl and stir gently until the uni is fully coated with the egg mixture.
Pour the melted butter into a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Add the uni and egg mixture to the baking dish and smooth the top.
Sprinkle the toasted Panko breadcrumbs over the top of the uni mixture.
Bake the dish in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the dish from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top.
Drizzle the freshly squeezed lemon juice over the top of the dish.
